prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
Rust does not allow a `#[repr(packed)]` type to contain a `#[repr(align(N))]` type, even indirectly. This produces E0588:

```rust
#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(i32);

#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(Aligned); // error
```

The restriction is transitive, so it also applies through intermediate structs, unions, or other nested types.

You also cannot put both hints on the same type:

```rust
#[repr(packed, align(8))]
struct Invalid(i32); // error E0587
```

The reverse nesting is allowed: a `#[repr(align(N))]` type may contain a `#[repr(packed)]` type.

```rust
#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(i32);

#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(Packed); // allowed
```

Using `#[repr(packed(N))]` does not remove the restriction when a nested type has `#[repr(align)]`. Rust currently rejects such combinations because GCC and MSVC differ in their layout behavior for packed types containing aligned members.
